Translated from the official Slovak paper (63. ročník Fyzikálnej olympiády v školskom roku 2021/2022, Kategória A, Celoštátne kolo – text úloh); the Slovak original is kept. The PDF (three pages) contains the four theory problems of the national round and, at the end, the colophon (authors, reviewers, Hungarian translator, editor, publisher), which is omitted; no solutions and no experimental problem. No points are printed in the paper. Decimal commas are kept in the Slovak text and written as decimal points in the English translation; the caption 'Obr.' is translated as 'Fig.'. The title 'Šikmý vrh 3' (Oblique throw 3) refers to a series of oblique-throw problems in earlier rounds of the same year; the opening italic paragraph alludes to them. The bounce counts '1×' and '2×' are kept as printed.
